push_subscribe_endpoint.notes: Saves push subscription with endpoint and keys. Requires authentication.

push_preferences_get.notes: Returns user preferences with defaults (marketing=false, others=true)

admin_send_push.notes: Admin can send push to all users, providers only, or specific user IDs. Creates in-app notifications too.

admin_push_history.notes: Returns history of sent push notifications with success/failed counts

service_worker.notes: Service worker accessible, handles push and notificationclick events

features: 7 notification type toggles (new_booking, booking_confirmed, booking_cancelled, new_message, provider_verified, system_updates, marketing)
Toggle switches save automatically with confirmation
Notification history table with title, body, target, recipients, date

frontend_subscription_flow: 1. usePushNotifications hook checks browser support (serviceWorker, PushManager, Notification)
5. Subscribes to PushManager with VAPID key
backend_send_flow: 1. Admin calls POST /api/admin/push/send with title, body, target
2. Backend fetches target users based on role filter
3. Backend fetches push subscriptions for those users
4. Uses pywebpush to send notifications to each subscription
5. Handles 404/410 responses by removing invalid subscriptions
